decisions.reason: The primary source empirically retests Smith et al. (2011) (Reference 7, PLoS ONE, doi: 10.1371/journal.pone.0025552) in new sample data by administering four of Smith et al.'s disgusting images in a preregistered replication extension (N=202) and conceptual replications, testing both whether physiological responses to disgusting images form a latent trait (Fig. 1 panel C; Supplementary Table 11) and whether skin conductance responses to those disgusting images correlate with social or economic conservatism (Fig. 2 row 3; Table 1 'Extension: Disgust Sensitivity'; Supplementary Tables 19–21). This is a separate empirical study and finding from the sole shipped row (input_row_index 1177, Oxley et al. 2008, Science, doi: 10.1126/science.1157627, which tested threat sensitivity). Note that while claim 3 also cites Reference 9 (Hibbing et al. 2014, Behavioral and Brain Sciences, a theoretical review), the Methods and Results establish that the empirical protocol and stimuli retested are from Smith et al.'s (2011) PLoS ONE article. Prior adjudication/state files do not exist for this work.
